source: read from Matterport model zvKHR9DHNjJ (5836 La Mirada Ave, Los Angeles, CA, 90038, US) by world/matterport.py: rooms, doorways and ceilings from the Model API's floor plan; furniture (808 boxes) and table tops (4) measured on the MatterPak mesh by world/mesh.py: anything standing between 0.1 and 2 m above the floor, away from the walls, boxed on a 0.1 m grid. Room outlines follow the middle of each wall, not its inner face, so rooms read up to half a wall (about 0.1 m) wider than they are. Left out, their walls do not close a loop: room_1, room_2, room_3
